dungeons.description: Abandoned Hideout

dungeons.name: Abandoned Memorial Room
dungeons.description: A place where the Nornir Priest Soirel would revere the memory of the dead alongside believers, until a sudden attack by the Balaur resulted in all those present having their souls taken from them. Now the memorial stands unmaintained and unvisited.

dungeons.name: Abandoned Odylium Cave
dungeons.description: Drawn by its rich veins of Odylium—a rarity in Odyle-depleted Verteron—, this cave is crawling with Sura who escaped the Nahid's Brigade's laboratories. Though it boasts a vault filled with treasures of long-dead Daeva, many of which contain Odylium, few dare approach due to the Sura threat.

dungeons.description: Abandoned Old Merchant HQ Site

dungeons.name: Abandoned One's Grave
dungeons.description: Even noble blood could not save you from the plague that began to spread after Odyle became depleted. Behit, the last remaining heir of a noble family that stayed outside the Bulwark, buried his family with his own hands after they became Karas, and then entered the Abandoned Grave and locked himself within.

dungeons.name: Akilo Thieves Den
dungeons.description: A den of the Akilo Thieves who have become somewhat notorious in the Ellun River Midstream.

dungeons.name: All-Curing Cave
dungeons.description: This cave is rumored to contain a miraculous cure-all mushroom.\\nBut none who've entered in search of it have ever returned.

dungeons.name: Altar of Hope
dungeons.description: A place where an ancient Zumion Priestess sealed herself away together with Meslamtaeda's poison, enduring intense agony as she continues her solitary battle.

dungeons.name: Amurahta Surveillance Base
dungeons.description: A Balaur base set up to monitor the area around Black Claw Village. Watch Commander Amurahta keeps a close eye to ensure the local Mau do their work efficiently, and extorts them for their supplies under the pretext of offering them protection.

dungeons.name: Ancient Ruins
dungeons.description: Ancient Ruins

dungeons.name: Andsha Forward Base
dungeons.description: An outpost manned by Balaur of the Lagta Brigade, built to support their research into destroying the Blood Barrier. Whether human or Shulak, any who dare approach Impetusium Square without permission are attacked indiscriminately.

dungeons.name: Anguish Hideout
dungeons.description: A cave where Daeva fleeing the Balaur hid while gathering their strength for a counterattack.

dungeons.name: Ardus Shrine
dungeons.description: A shrine to Illusion God Kaisinel, built by his own order before the Second Great Catastrophe.\\nArdus Shrine and its surroundings were crystallized by energy from the Spirit Realm and the power of Kaisinel, and now glows with a blackish-purple light much like Kaisinel's own brilliance. The surrounding vegetation absorbs the energy to grow lush, and glows too at night.

dungeons.name: Ascetic's Cave
dungeons.description: A hidden refuge where the Reckless Jonas, who fled the Blades fearing punishment, hides with his followers. It was once a sanctuary for ascetics' training.

dungeons.name: Astin's Secret Hideout
dungeons.description: Astin's Secret Hideout

dungeons.name: Aullaeu Altar
dungeons.description: When the Aullaeu crossed over to the Verteron, they worshipped the new Dragon Lord Ishtar as their god at ceremonial sites like this.

dungeons.description: Aullaeu Funeral Island

dungeons.name: Aullaeu Oratory

dungeons.name: Azure Breath Island
dungeons.description: An island located in a remote corner of the Atreian seas.\\nAfter the Great Catastrophe, tectonic shifts in the area of the island caused a massive amount of Fafnite Gemstones in the water to shatter and smash into the island with great force.\\nThis resulted in a massive ordeal for the flora and fauna of the island. Organisms that were poisoned by the Fafnite Gemstones lost their minds or shriveled up, until eventually only those who managed to adapt by expelling the Azure Breath were left.

dungeons.description: An outpost garrisoned by Balaur of the Lagta Brigade. Responsible for hunting down any local resistance, they are notorious for being among the most brutal of the Balaur.

dungeons.name: Blue Dragon's Trap
dungeons.description: A place where the Fafnium used throughout the Sanctum Outpost is managed by the Lagta Brigade. The Lagta Brigade has been using Fafnium created by Dragon Lord Fafnir to steal the souls of countless Daeva and control their empty flesh. This place is being guarded by Sentinel Nuraka of the Lagta Brigade.

dungeons.description: A site assumed to be a former part of Zumion Temple. Now little more than broken ruins, perhaps it might contain records of ancient times.

dungeons.description: A library built in Altamia Canyon by the librarian Hypatia. Fearing it would be attacked and the accumulated knowledge within lost, she distributed the books across multiple other libraries.

dungeons.name: Cave of the Defeated
dungeons.description: The battle at the Nahid Brigade Fortress ended in total defeat for the Daeva. Many were captured or succumbed to extinction, and what few survived went into hiding in places such as the Cave of the Defeated.

rewardItems.name: Title: In the Heart of Enemy Territory

dungeons.name: Cave of the Desperate
dungeons.description: This cave is where defeated Guardians hid from the Balaur and eventually met their ends. It holds the records of the Guardians of Verteron, who fought a fierce battle against the Ishtar Brigade.

dungeons.name: Cave Storage
dungeons.description: A place to store the Aullaeu's belongings. Pinos, Aullaeu's minions, serve as laborers.

dungeons.name: Chaotic Lower Reshanta
dungeons.description: Reshanta, located in the Abyss—the subspace created from the unstable energies of the split AION Tower—has long been a battlefield where the Elyos, Asmodian, and Balaur clash.\\nAccess to Reshanta had been forbidden for a time due to the Odyle storm unleashed by the collapse of AION over 200 years ago, but a century later, Daeva were once again allowed to enter it.\\n \\nBut now, Reshanta has turned into a realm that is twisted beyond recognition by the aftermath of the collapse. The world beyond the base shifted unpredictably, sometimes even linking to the same faction in entirely different dimensions. The Daeva fell into anguish and confusion when they were forced to confront others who bore wings of the same color as their own.\\n \\nYet, they could not halt their advance. Unlike Elysea and Asmodae, where Odyle has been dwindling, Reshanta still brimmed with abundant Odyle left behind by the storm. They face a grim fate now, and to survive, they must raise their blades even against their own kind.

dungeons.name: Chaotic Middle Reshanta
dungeons.description: One day, Daeva using the dimensional portal to the Abyss began to report highly unusual occurrences. Upon passing through the portal, they would arrive at an unfamiliar location whose existence was entirely unrecorded. The area appeared above the location of a powerful Odyle storm in the lower layer of Reshanta, and so it came to be called Middle Reshanta.\\n\\nVisitors would report the impossibility of flying, and investigations eventually found that the flow of Odyle in the middle layer was unique: Odyle continuously flowed down from the middle layer to the lower layer. Long flights were easy thanks to the high concentration of Odyle in the lower layer, whereas even spreading one's wings was a challenge in the middle.\\n\\nThis strengthened the Balaur and other hostile forces that were not dependent on Odyle, making them an even greater threat in the middle layer. As a result, the Daeva selected and dispatched are elite combatants striving to eradicate the hostile forces there.

dungeons.name: Chilly Hideout
dungeons.description: It is not uncommon for those undergoing Sura mutation to deny reality and seek to return to their original forms by curing their symptoms, hiding away as they conduct research through often unethical methods.

dungeons.name: Clione Lake Cave
dungeons.description: A mysterious cave shrouded in mystery. There is a legend that Daeva sought it out in the past for ascension.

dungeons.name: Closed Hideout
dungeons.description: Karas fled the village to this cave, but their fate could not be avoided. Though sealed in the past, the ravages of time have once again reopened this Karas-infested den. They continue to lurk within, mad and hungry for prey.

dungeons.name: Coastal Cave
dungeons.description: A cave located along the coastal cliffs of the Western Cantas Valley, a region once rich in Odylium.\\nIt is rarely visited due to rumors of Sura being discovered inside.\\nAt some point, a mysterious barrier appeared at the cave entrance.

dungeons.description: The underground part of the fallen Verteron Fortress. It is used by the Krall as their residence.

dungeons.name: Collapsed Oracle
dungeons.description: This Oracle was built within Uruthumheim and used extensively by the Three Women of Fate—Skuld, Urd, and Verdandi.\\nDistressed by the gradual loss of their power to see fate as AION grew weaker and weaker, they built this oracle and locked themselves away within in search of glimpses of Atreia's future.\\nUnable to read the fate of Atreia in its entirety as they used to, they decided to go their separate ways in search of their own methods for discerning Atreia's future.\\nFollowing its abandonment, the Oracle was partially destroyed by Dredgion bombardment, but the most important spaces survived, with traps in place to prevent the Balaur and outlaws from trespassing.

dungeons.name: Corrupted Spiritmaster's Residence
dungeons.description: A cave serving as the hiding place of Deios, a corrupted Spiritmaster who was one of many who lost their way following Kaisinel's extinction and the dissolution of the Illusion Cavaliers. Out of sight of other Daeva, Deios has been researching dangerous magic in hopes of finding a way to control the spirits of Etheria.

dungeons.name: Cradle of Nihility
dungeons.description: The collapse of AION Tower tore dimensions asunder, and it was into one such tear that Legion Commander Bakarma was drawn. Enduring an almost infinite span of time within Draupnir, a subspace that has absorbed the energy of countless other dimensions, he, too, accumulated immense power. Now broken free from the bonds of his physical form, Bakarma has become a transcendent being, agonizing over how to reshape the universe in his image.

But none returned, and none survived.

dungeons.description: Sura are Daeva who mutated after having all of their life energy drained by the Balaur. A number of Sura secluded themselves in caves while they still retained their sanity, attempting to halt their mutation. Ultimately, however, all succumbed to their fate of becoming mindless monsters.

dungeons.name: Deep Underground Cave
dungeons.description: Inherently inquisitive, the Creion are famed for seeking out dangerous places to conduct dangerous experiments. This cave is one of many such places, abandoned following an experiment that ended in failure. However, perhaps they left some valuable items behind.

After the collapse of the AION Tower, Draupnir Cave was swept away in the chaos of Atreia and fell into the Abyss.\\nWhile wandering the Abyss, Bakarma discovered a power that did not exist in Atreia and sought to use it to become a being transcending the Balaur.

All information from the past, present, and future flows through this sacred space, and only those with the power of AION can access it.

dungeons.description: A hiding place of Daeva who have strayed from the Daeva path and now serve the Balaur.

dungeons.name: Empty Cave
dungeons.description: An ancient cave where the Lepharist once conducted Krao experiments. Now abandoned, but the test subjects are said to still wander around the cave.

dungeons.name: Etheria Rift
dungeons.description: A dimensional rift created by the disruption of the boundary between Atreia and Etheria.\\nEtheria, the realm of the Spirits, was separated from Atreia by a contract between the Empyrean Lords and the Spirit Kings. However, when Kaisinel and Lumiel disappeared and the contract with the Spirits grew weak, rifts leading to Etheria began to appear across Atreia, and the rampaging Spirit King attempted to expand the spread of the rifts as well as his control over all of Atreia's Spirits.

dungeons.description: Fallen Relic Storage

dungeons.name: Fanatics' Den
dungeons.description: Within this cave, Zikel's zealots recklessly offer sacrifices in twisted faith. The gathered offerings of victims are presented as tribute to Zikel.

dungeons.description: A den of the Ferocious Horn Mau tribe, located in the Abyss.\\nThrough constant use of Fafnite, the Ferocious Horn Mau managed to survive within the Abyss, but many lives were lost on the way.\\nAfter fully embracing the power of Fafnite, the Ferocious Horn tribe is now pioneering a new life in the Abyss while keeping the memory of the fallen alive.

dungeons.description: A cave located in the Contaminated Marsh, polluted by the sewage and refuse of Nahid Brigade Fortress and the Drana Plantation. Hidden among the waste are a number of documents detailing the Balaur's Surana experiments.

dungeons.name: Final Haven
dungeons.description: In their darkest hour, a number of Daeva gathered all they had and fled to a hidden cave behind the Basfelt Waterfall. Some ventured out to scout but never returned. Overcome by fear, those left behind stayed in this final refuge, waiting and slowly fading away.

dungeons.name: Fire Temple
dungeons.description: The Fire Temple was once a sight of pilgrimage for Ancient Daeva, where they gave their relics as offerings. Kromede, the fallen Silent Judicator and passionate treasure hunter, infiltrated the Fire Temple with her eyes set on these relics, only to be consumed by the Mirror of Desire. Ever since, Desire given shape in the form of Kromede has continued to tempt those who visit the Temple.

dungeons.name: Fire Temple
dungeons.description: The Fire Temple was once a sight of pilgrimage for Ancient Daeva, where they gave their relics as offerings. Kromede, the fallen Silent Judicator and passionate treasure hunter, infiltrated the Fire Temple with her eyes set on these relics, only to be consumed by the Mirror of Desire. Ever since, Desire given shape in the form of Kromede has continued to tempt those who visit the Temple.

dungeons.name: First Stage
dungeons.description: First Stage

dungeons.name: Fissure Cave
dungeons.description: A cave where a passage to the unstable Abyss has appeared. It contains information about the Ancient City of Roah.

dungeons.name: Flauke Legion Outpost
dungeons.description: An outpost now held by the Flauke Legion. Once protectors of the Purifying Forest, they became deeply demoralized after suffering a brutal defeat to the Balaur. Driven by the power of Fafnite, Commander Flauke is now guilty of innumerous atrocities.

dungeons.name: Forest Library
dungeons.description: A secret library built in Tolbas Forest by the librarian Hypatia to preserve the knowledge of the Elyos.

dungeons.name: Forest Marauder Campsite
dungeons.description: Forest Marauder Campsite

dungeons.name: Forest Shade Execution Site
dungeons.description: Forest Shade Execution Site

dungeons.name: Forest Shade Execution Site Treasure Storage
dungeons.description: Forest Shade Execution Site Treasure Storage

dungeons.name: Fortress Grave
dungeons.description: A burial vault beneath Verteron Fortress. It likely contains a great number of Daeva relics, with its underground location having allowed it to escape Balaur bombardment.

dungeons.name: Fortress Jail
dungeons.description: A jail situated under Verteron Fortress. though currently under Krall control, it still contains many relics and writings of Illusion Cavaliers.

dungeons.name: Fortuneteller's Grave
dungeons.description: The Three Sisters of Fate who lead the Nornir are brilliant diviners and prophets. Some of their students once claimed to be greater prophets than their teachers, only to meet their end in this cave after they hid away in fear of a future where they saw themselves turning into Karas.

dungeons.name: Fossa Sighting Location
dungeons.description: Fossa Sighting Location

dungeons.name: Fungie Habitat
dungeons.description: A cave containing abnormal amounts of Fungie. Rumor says that treasure lies deep within, but none have successfully ventured far enough inside.

dungeons.name: Gargos Thieves Campsite
dungeons.description: Gargos Thieves Campsite

dungeons.name: Granach's Hideout
dungeons.description: A hideout of wanted criminals who originally worked for the Steel Hammer Merchants until they were caught smuggling goods. Now settled in the Eastern Gribade Highland, they continue to target passing merchants.

dungeons.name: Grave of the Wrathful Dead
dungeons.description: After being defeated by Ishtar's armies, some Daeva suffered extinction, some became Sura, and some even became Apparitions. The wrathful screams of those Daeva Apparitions are heard day and night.

dungeons.name: Graverobber Den
dungeons.description: A den of grave robber Daeva obsessed with an relic buried in a tomb. They've set up camp near the cemetery and are causing havoc. They are notorious even among fellow grave robbers.

dungeons.name: Grisilla's Hideout
dungeons.description: Grisilla's Hideout

dungeons.name: Guardian's Armory
dungeons.description: A secret armory of the Guardians who resisted the Balaur to the last. No one knows if there are still any useful weapons.

dungeons.name: Hall of Illusion
dungeons.description: A hall built by Reda, High Priestess of Illusion, as she wandered the continent searching for her lost daughter.\\nSeeing her daughter's future reflected in Daeva who had become Sura and specters unable to return to Odyle, she summoned them here.\\nAfter obtaining the Mirror of Desire once used by Kromede, Reda used it to sever her obsessive attachment to her daughter from herself and seal it within the hall.

dungeons.name: Hall of Illusion
dungeons.description: A hall built by Reda, High Priestess of Illusion, as she wandered the continent searching for her lost daughter.\\nSeeing her daughter's future reflected in Daeva who had become Sura and specters unable to return to Odyle, she summoned them here.\\nAfter obtaining the Mirror of Desire once used by Kromede, Reda used it to sever her obsessive attachment to her daughter from herself and seal it within the hall.

dungeons.name: Herb Cave
dungeons.description: A cave known to grow rare herbs. However, the animals that ate the herbs grew too strong, and the cave became inaccessible to humans.

dungeons.name: Hermit's Cave
dungeons.description: Hermit's Cave

dungeons.name: Hidden Chapel
dungeons.description: Hidden Chapel

dungeons.name: Hidden Ruins Altar
dungeons.description: The place where Spatalos, former high commander of the Verteron Legion, sealed away Vamana, a vanguard captain of the Drakan. According to folklore, the echoes of their battle can still be heard.

dungeons.name: Hidden Storage
dungeons.description: Hidden Storage

dungeons.name: Hidden Valley
dungeons.description: A deep gorge formed by tectonic shifts.\\nSuspicious individuals of unknown identity have regularly been seen coming and going.

dungeons.name: Hidden Vein Cave
dungeons.description: A hidden cave rich in rare minerals. Crystalline monsters are swarming within.

dungeons.name: High Priest's Ruins
dungeons.description: The body of High Priest Hystan, whose soul and mind were stolen by Fafnite, roamed Altgard and slaughtered countless people. When Hystan's body arrived in Moslan Forest, the Nornir gathered the Daeva and sealed the High Priest's body. They left a stele in memory of his victims, containing the truth about High Priest Hystan, and make offerings there.

dungeons.name: Highland Cave
dungeons.description: Highland Cave

dungeons.name: Homish's Prison Compound
dungeons.description: Producing Fafnite always requires live human or Daeva. For this, Drakan Homish built the prison compound for imprisoning both human and Daeva.

dungeons.name: Howling Den
dungeons.description: The Mutated Varg Test Subjects were once human, but no longer remembers who they were. Guarding the treasure as commanded is all they know.

dungeons.name: Illicit Trade Spot
dungeons.description: A cave not often visited by the villagers of Aullaeu in Tolbas Forest. It seems to be the site of suspicious trade.

dungeons.name: Illusion Hideout
dungeons.description: Once an altar to Kaisinel visited by numerous worshippers and guarded by a spirit summoned by the High Priestess of Illusion, after the High Priestess abandoned her duties, it was sealed and became no more than a ruin. But the spirit still guards it, waiting for its mistress to return.

dungeons.name: Illusion Oratory
dungeons.description: Illusion Oratory

dungeons.name: Illusion Sanctum
dungeons.description: A sanctum in the Verteron Fortress Ruins. When Verteron Fortress was invaded, the Illusion Cavaliers took their artifacts and made their last stand in this place. In order to defend the sanctum, the Illusion Cavaliers set up various defenses inside.

dungeons.name: Illusion-Seeped Cave
dungeons.description: Illusion-Seeped Cave

dungeons.name: Illusionary Ruins
dungeons.description: A cave where pilgrims worshipping the Illusion God practiced meditation. The High Priestess of Illusion summoned Spirits to guard this place for the pilgrims, but after strange things began happening in the garden following her disappearance, pilgrims gradually stopped coming.\\nNow, only the Spirits remain, guarding an empty cave.

dungeons.name: Impetusium
dungeons.description: The place where Zikel and the Destruction Archons fought against Dragon Lord Fafnir until the bitter end. Nobody can enter because of the barrier formed by Zikel's spilled blood.

dungeons.name: In Front of Azrakar Brigade Prison Compound
Insectoid Tunnel
dungeons.description: The ground beneath Altgard is weakening due to underground tunnels used by the burrowing insectoid. It is said the burrowing insectoids dwell in this cave.

dungeons.name: Kaisinel's Collapsed Sanctum
dungeons.description: Once a sanctum under the administration of the High Priestess of Illusion, it has since been neglected and turned to ruins.\\nWhile waiting in vain for their Empyrean Lord's return, the priests were captured by the Balaur and turned into Sura, who now attack anyone who enters the sanctum.

dungeons.name: Karat's Nest
dungeons.description: After the destruction of the Abyss Gate of Verteron Fortress, some of the Klaw that lived in the Abyss have settled in the Verteron Fortress Ruins. The Klaw queen, Karat, spawns from her nest and seeks to expand their territory.

dungeons.name: Kidnapper's Hold
dungeons.description: Ishtar developed a technology called Surana capable of extracting the life force of Daeva and converting it into alternative energy. To facilitate research and development, numerous groups of Balaur dedicated themselves to systematically hunting Daeva and other lifeforms for use as experimental subjects, imprisoning them in nearby bases and supplying them to Nahid Brigade Fortress whenever needed.

dungeons.name: Kius' Residence
dungeons.description: A base belonging to the notorious criminal Kius and his followers. The bounty on his head from the Notos Legion has grown higher and higher, but no one has dared attempt to capture him.

dungeons.name: Klaw Den
dungeons.description: A cave where a group of Klaw live. It is said that there is a special herb that grows in the Klaw habitat.

dungeons.name: Konutin's Cave
dungeons.description: A cave used by Aullaeu Shamans for their ritual studies, guarded by Konutins stationed in the area.

dungeons.name: Kraka's Altar
dungeons.description: The resting place of Kraka, a legendary chieftain of the Tursin Krall. The Krall worship him still—building altars and offering tribute.

dungeons.name: Krall Barracks
dungeons.description: Krall are assigned by the Balaur to handle the disposal of the large amounts of waste produced by experiments conducted in Nahid Brigade Fortress, and of the byproducts produced by the nearby Drana Plantation. The number of Krall specialized in these tasks is substantial enough to require an entire barracks.

dungeons.name: Krao Cave
dungeons.description: Krao Cave is rich in a special mineral called Krao, known for its ability to repel external forces.\\nLepharists conducted various experiments with Krao here and, during the Last War, created the powerful Berk, which played a key role in the conflict.\\nBut when Berk went berserk and lost control, the Lepharists sealed the cave and withdrew.

dungeons.name: Krao Cave
dungeons.description: Krao Cave is rich in a special mineral called Krao, known for its ability to repel external forces.\\nLepharists conducted various experiments with Krao here and, during the Last War, created the powerful Berk, which played a key role in the conflict.\\nBut when Berk went berserk and lost control, the Lepharists sealed the cave and withdrew.

dungeons.description: Krao Cave is rich in a special mineral called Krao, known for its ability to repel external forces.\\nLepharists conducted various experiments with Krao here and, during the Last War, created the powerful Berk, which played a key role in the conflict.\\nBut when Berk went berserk and lost control, the Lepharists sealed the cave and withdrew.

dungeons.name: Kumbahum's Cave
dungeons.description: A cave used by those seeking the Balaur power over honor of the Mau. Followers of Shaman Kumbahum are growing in strength here.

dungeons.name: Lagta Fafnite Storage
dungeons.description: One of the Lagta Brigade's Fafnite Storages, overseen by the Supervisor Sinah.

dungeons.name: Lagta Underground Cage
dungeons.description: Lagta Underground Cage

dungeons.name: Lamnah Base
dungeons.description: A cave claimed as a base by a Draconute warband led by Lamnah, the ruthless Scouts Captain of the Lagta Brigade.

dungeons.name: Latrima Outpost
dungeons.description: An outpost of elite Balaur forces monitoring and patrolling Dranactus. They oversee Drana cultivation while keeping watch over the area. A teleportation device allows them to rapidly reinforce their forces, making this a key base.

dungeons.name: Legion Base Ruins
dungeons.description: A site where a small legion resisting the Balaur was annihilated. Daeva soldiers whose bodies and souls have been split now wander aimlessly. The Balaur intend to seal these specters within the ruins and repurpose them into an immortal brigade.

dungeons.name: Library of Foresight
dungeons.description: A secret library built in Moslan Forest by Musein, a librarian who sought to preserve the knowledge of the Asmodians. Whispers tell of ancient tomes containing information on the Bulwark.

dungeons.name: Library of Patience
dungeons.description: A secret library built in Basfelt by Musein, a librarian who sought to preserve the knowledge of the Asmodians. Whispers tell of ancient tomes containing information on the Bulwark.

dungeons.name: Library of Wisdom
dungeons.description: A secret library built by the librarian Musein to preserve the knowledge of the Asmodians, under the sworn protection of the Kerubar. Whispers tell of ancient tomes containing information on the Bulwark.

dungeons.name: Logger's Rest Ruins
dungeons.description: Logger's Rest Ruins

dungeons.name: Lonely Rock Chasm
dungeons.description: An abandoned cave where a Daeva who betrayed the Blades was imprisoned, tortured, and left to die. It is said the restless spirit of this traitor, together with those of other murdered Daeva, haunts and attacks any who pass through.

dungeons.name: Looted Pilgrim's Rest
dungeons.description: A site of pilgrimage where worshippers of Kaisinel stop and write devotionals. Popularized by a legend that he once stayed here briefly, it is now home only to lost spirits.

dungeons.name: Looted Repository
dungeons.description: A granary used by the residents of Verteron until Dratona forces turned it into a Balaur lair. The Dratona captain, Nagto, has wasted no time in pocketing the accumulated grain.

dungeons.name: Lost Ruins
dungeons.description: A cave where a rift to the unstable Abyss has appeared. It contains information about the secrets of the Ancient City of Roah.

dungeons.name: Lupyllini Habitat
dungeons.description: A cave deep within the secluded reaches of Cantas Valley, chosen by the Lupyllini to make their nests. Long used by bandits from nearby mountains to hide their plundered treasures, the presence of Lupyllini has made it all but impossible for humans to approach, leaving the treasures piled inside to gather dust with nobody to lay claim to them.

dungeons.description: Maktashan Outpost

dungeons.description: Maktashan Outpost Treasure Storage

dungeons.name: Marsh Library
dungeons.description: A secret library built by the librarian Hypatia to preserve the knowledge of the Elyos, under the sworn protection of the Kerubar. Whispers tell of ancient tomes containing information on the Bulwark.

dungeons.description: Merchant's Yard

dungeons.description: Miros Post Treasure Storage

dungeons.name: Moonwatcher Sky Island
dungeons.description: Moonwatcher Sky Island

dungeons.name: Mysterious Grotto
dungeons.description: A grotto hidden along Mahindel River, currently used as a laboratory by the Creion—a research organization formed by Lepharists trying to find an alternative energy source to Odyle. They have conducted various studies in this pursuit and also invented many things, including the Selvis.

dungeons.name: Mysterious Mushroom Cave
dungeons.description: The Cantas Valley is home to a colony of giant mushrooms that grow higher than the trees. These giant mushrooms greatly favor caves with moist soil and adequate humidity.

dungeons.name: Mysterious Ruins
dungeons.description: Mysterious Ruins

dungeons.name: Nahid Disposal Plant
dungeons.description: A place where the Balaur dispose of contaminants and living beings used in their experiments, namely Daeva.\\nAs immortal demigods, Daeva are not easily destroyed, no matter how brutally they are experimented upon.\\nInstead of looking for ways to dispose of Daeva who have exhausted their usefulness, the Balaur decided simply to abandon them to die on their own.\\nAs such, the Chimera Dumpsite has accumulated two centuries worth of discarded experimental subjects, becoming a hellish place filled with contaminants and creatures driven purely by violent instinct, no longer recognizable as the Daeva they once were.

dungeons.description: Odyle Jelly Storage

dungeons.name: Odylium Marauder Den
dungeons.description: A storage housing the Blades' Odylium marauders. Fortified with powerful security devices, it holds vital documents tied to Odylium.

dungeons.name: Odylium Repository
dungeons.description: One of many secret locations recently discovered in Atreia, used by the Balaur to store Odylium for study. Odyle Energy fused with souls can be obtained from the Odylium within, which has been distorted and rendered unstable by cruel Balaur experiments.

dungeons.name: Old Empty House
dungeons.description: Old Empty House

dungeons.name: Old Graveyard
dungeons.description: A graveyard established at a time when countless humans and Daeva were dying daily. The sheer amount of souls laid to rest here, most deprived even of the dignity of being named, has made it a place few wish to step foot near. An increasing number of graverobbers, however, are taking note of rumors of buried treasures.

dungeons.name: Old Hideout
dungeons.description: Old Hideout

dungeons.name: Old House
dungeons.description: Old House

dungeons.name: Old Mercenaries Stronghold
dungeons.description: Old Mercenaries Stronghold

dungeons.name: Old Stone Chamber
dungeons.description: Old Stone Chamber

dungeons.name: Ossuary of the Noble
dungeons.description: During the Karas massacres, even the nobles could not escape their fate. Altgard's slaughterers herded the noble families suspected of being Karas into a single ossuary and imprisoned them.

dungeons.name: Penitent Altar
dungeons.description: Penitent Altar

dungeons.name: Pilgrim's Rest
dungeons.description: Pilgrim's Rest

dungeons.name: Pirate's Treasure Storage
dungeons.description: A pirates' treasure storage hidden beneath Idun's Lake. After being discovered and claimed by the Blades, it has been managed by Custodian Chakkerman.

dungeons.name: Place of Rest
dungeons.description: A valley where Daeva resisting the Balaur invasion sought refuge, only to have it become their tomb following a Dredgion bombardment. Many who fought here had been serving since even before the Balaur invasion.

dungeons.name: Plantation Storage
dungeons.description: A Balaur storage that stores Drana, Drana by-products, and the supplies needed to grow Drana.

dungeons.name: Plateau Hill Base
dungeons.description: Plateau Hill Base

dungeons.name: Poacher's Base
dungeons.description: Poacher's Base

dungeons.name: Poacher's Den
dungeons.description: The cliffs of the Cantas Valley feature natural caves of various shapes and sizes, favored as hideouts by the many poachers who ply their illicit trade in and around the valley.

dungeons.name: Poisonous Plant Habitat
dungeons.description: The miasma grows stronger day by day in a cave full of poisonous plants. Inside, the amount of agrints and slimes contaminated by the plants is steadily rising.

dungeons.name: Predator's Lair
dungeons.description: Most of the Varg who escaped from the Lepharist Research Center became minions of the Dragon Lords, but some of them scattered and formed their own packs. The Varg who have settled in caves near the Purifying Forest slaughter or capture rare animals in the forest for illegal trade.

dungeons.name: Prison of Exiles
dungeons.description: An exile colony home to legionnaires and Cavaliers who committed heinous crimes. Following the Balaur occupation of Verteron, it fell under Aullaeu control and now imprisons those banished from the Urugugu tribe.

rewardItems.name: Title: I Take Care of My Own

dungeons.name: Prison of Oblivion
dungeons.description: An underground prison where those defeated in war were locked away. Over the years, the long-forgotten Prison of Oblivion has become filled only with restless dead and swarming rats, but rumors whisper of a lost chronicle hidden deep within its walls.

dungeons.name: Quai Merchants Temporary Storage
dungeons.description: Quai Merchants Temporary Storage

dungeons.name: Recommended Odyle Gathering Site
dungeons.description: Recommended Odyle Gathering Site

dungeons.name: Red Dragon Altar
dungeons.description: The Aullaeu worshipped Dragon Lord Tiamat for generations. Even following her fall and the ascendance of Dragon Lord Ishtar, they did not falter in their worship, and continue to dedicate altars to her.

dungeons.name: Relic Storage
dungeons.description: Relic Storage

dungeons.name: Renegade Base
dungeons.description: There are Daeva who, despite not being Sura, have strayed from the Daeva path and sworn to serve the Balaur. This cave is the home to such Daeva Renegades.

dungeons.name: Renegade Daeva Hideout
dungeons.description: Renegade Daeva Hideout

dungeons.description: Renegade Hideout

dungeons.description: Renegade Hideout Treasure Storage

dungeons.name: Reuben's Hideout
dungeons.description: Reuben's Hideout

dungeons.name: Rift Cave
dungeons.description: A cave where a passage to the unstable Abyss has appeared. It contains additional information about the Ancient City of Roah.

dungeons.name: Rift Fissure
dungeons.description: A rift fissure said to lead to the Ancient City of Roah, known only among explorers.\\nRoah's records are rumored to be hidden in this cave.

dungeons.name: Rock Cave
dungeons.description: Revelations of Khalil foretells the Daeva' fate. A fragment of this prophecy is said to be hidden within this Rock Cave, now held by the Kalgolem.

dungeons.name: Romlon's Hideout
dungeons.description: Romlon's Hideout

dungeons.name: Romlon's Hideout Treasure Storage
dungeons.description: Romlon's Hideout Treasure Storage

dungeons.name: Root Cellar
dungeons.description: A root cavity created by the deep roots of a large and old tree in the Tolbas Forest.\\nIt once served as an assembly hall and chapel for Aullaeu Village. Now it is used to store food, weapons, and ceremonial items for the whole tribe.

dungeons.name: Root of the Sacred Tree
dungeons.description: The interior of the Sacred Tree Grisilla.\\nDuring the war, the Balaur drilled a hole into the Sacred Tree that protected the forest, with the goal of destroying it.\\nDaeva ventured inside, hoping to stop the Balaur, only to be defeated following a brutal battle.\\nThe Poison Blood left behind by the Dragon Lord clings to the roots of Grisilla, contaminating them deeply and driving the Spirits of the forest to madness.

dungeons.name: Rubek Thieves' Occupied Territory
dungeons.description: The main base of a bandit group occupying Calderon Canyon. They expanded their power using illegal explosives and now pillage anyone in sight, human or Shugo alike.

dungeons.name: Rubek Thieves' Occupied Territory Treasure Storage
Ruins of the Ancient City of Roah
dungeons.description: According to legend, the Ancient City of Roah was the pinnacle of Atreian civilization until it was swept away by the Abyss and disappeared.\\nNobody knew where this magnificent city of the past had vanished to, with only the merest fragments discovered in Reshanta.\\n\\n\\nBy tracing the wavelength of Roah's Heart, a relic of the Ancient City, the tenacious relic-seeking Shulak of the Shuliman Expedition were able to discover the city's ruins, along with the shifting Abyss connected to them.\\nMany adventurers were drawn by rumors of a relic of Israphel, but the entrance to the shifting Abyss was expensive to maintain and frequently closed.\\n\\nFinding out what lies inside remains the life goal of many an adventurer.

dungeons.name: Ruins of the Ancient City of Roah
dungeons.description: According to legend, the Ancient City of Roah was the pinnacle of Atreian civilization until it was swept away by the Abyss and disappeared.\\nNobody knew where this magnificent city of the past had vanished to, with only the merest fragments discovered in Reshanta.\\n\\n\\nBy tracing the wavelength of Roah's Heart, a relic of the Ancient City, the tenacious relic-seeking Shulak of the Shuliman Expedition were able to discover the city's ruins, along with the shifting Abyss connected to them.\\nMany adventurers were drawn by rumors of a relic of Israphel, but the entrance to the shifting Abyss was expensive to maintain and frequently closed.\\n\\nFinding out what lies inside remains the life goal of many an adventurer.

dungeons.description: An outpost established by the Balaur outside the Sanctum Outpost. Though disguised as a simple outpost, it is actually a facility for testing Draconute modification, with many violent Draconutes who have slipped beyond Drakan control.

rewardItems.name: Title: The Only Way Out Is Through

dungeons.name: Scale Altar
dungeons.description: An altar where Naga Wasti performs rites to strengthen the Dragon Lord's power. Wasti is a mighty warrior, feared as the Daeva slayer.

dungeons.description: Scarlotus Experiment Site

dungeons.name: Scribe's Room
dungeons.description: The Scribe's Room is believed that it was part of the Zumion Temple. The scribe left behind many records, but those on paper have been weathered away by time, and only a few stone tablets remain.

dungeons.description: Originally a plain old cave in the Nameless Cemetery, it later became a place where Karas were trapped and killed.\\nRumor has it that those who were buried alive are still haunting the cave even after death. Unsurprisingly, none have dared approach to confirm this.

dungeons.description: A den imprisoning Razekin, a Shulak who survived Fafnite dust poisoning but lost his mind entirely.

dungeons.name: Silent Graveyard
dungeons.description: A land littered with ruined tombs and ancient relics, now overrun by wraiths and other undead.\\nThough abandoned, this land untouched by time boasts buried riches and long-forgotten resources.

dungeons.name: Skurv Laborer Den
dungeons.description: A brutal training ground where Mumu Laborers strive to become warriors. Those who break under the overseer's strict training are cast into the prison's grip.

dungeons.name: Small House
dungeons.description: Small House

dungeons.name: Smuggler's Cave
dungeons.description: Some of the Shulak criminals who roamed the Abyss continued their criminal activities even after settling in Altgard. In particular, a smuggler named Sumakhi will stop at nothing to make a profit and is now notorious among Daeva and humans for his brutality.

dungeons.name: Solitary Rock Tomb
dungeons.description: A cave that now stands as a tomb to pilgrims who succumbed to Sura mutation. Their fellow Illusion God pilgrims continue to pray inside, wishing them peaceful slumber, but the Sura—whose grudges run deep—may awaken again at any moment.

rewardItems.name: Title: Pilgrim to the Holy Land

dungeons.name: South of Verteron Fortress Ruins
dungeons.description: South of Verteron Fortress Ruins

dungeons.name: Spider Cave
dungeons.description: Rumors whisper of treasure hidden in this abandoned Odylium mine, but all who have ventured inside fell victim to swarms of Odyle Spiders.

dungeons.name: Spirit Flower Cave
dungeons.description: Spirit Flowers have been known to grow in some hidden caves along the middle reaches of the Ellun River. Once common, they have become increasingly rare due to pollution and indiscriminate illegal harvesting for use as a medicinal herb or ingredients for magic. A number of groups have occupied the caves and are indiscriminately harvesting Spirit Flowers illegally.

dungeons.name: Spirit Temple
dungeons.description: Spirit Temple

dungeons.name: Submerged Life Temple
dungeons.description: Once a sacred temple imbued with Yustiel's blessings and the very essence of life, a dimensional rift caused it to become submerged in an unknown place, where it was transformed into an underwater dimension where light and even time are distorted.\\nAs a result, the resident Daeva had their own life essence warped, twisting their physical forms beyond recognition. They now retain only the instinct to protect their temple.

dungeons.description: Suspicious Cave

dungeons.name: Targoth's Cave
dungeons.description: A cave used for mass burial of those killed by Meslamtaeda's poison. After consuming the contaminated corpses, the Targos inside have mutated and taken over the cave for themselves.

dungeons.name: Tarzel Depository
dungeons.description: Tarzel Depository

dungeons.name: Tayga Breeding Ground
dungeons.description: A breeding ground for raising Tayga, the beasts wielded by the Black Claw Mau. The breeding ground is always full bloodshed and howling from these beasts.

dungeons.name: Temporary Clinic
dungeons.description: Temporary Clinic

dungeons.name: Treasure Hunter's Residence
dungeons.description: Long ago, treasure hunters fled to an abandoned ruin to escape a Balaur assault. They perished after being trapped within, and lingered on as vengeful revenants. Driven mad, they came to regard the ancient tome within as a priceless treasure, and now serve as its guardians.

dungeons.name: Trickster's Den
dungeons.description: A den of criminals exiled from Safe Haven, led by Korhe, who tore the village apart with his trickery. It is rumored to be filled with valuables and other loot stolen from the village.

dungeons.name: Tunapre Lake Cave
dungeons.description: A mysterious cave with a hidden entrance by the lake.\\nThere is a legend that Daeva sought it out in the past in order to ascend.

dungeons.name: Twisted Pit
dungeons.description: A twisted pit said to lead to the Ancient City of Roah, known only among explorers.\\nRoah's records are rumored to be hidden here.

dungeons.name: Unstable Cave
dungeons.description: A underwater cave lair of Daine of Tears, the Water Spirit, who escaped from the cave where the Etheria Rift formed. The spirit without the pact-bearer is now in a highly unstable state.

dungeons.name: Urugugu Canyon
dungeons.description: A canyon occupied by the Urugugu Tribe of Aullaeu who worship Ishtar, the Crimson Dragon Lord. The Urugugu village and altar are hidden inside the canyon.\\nUrugugu Canyon is guarded by Auldor, a sacred bird summoned by Urugugu Shamans using Ishtar's power.

dungeons.name: Vakron Sky Island
dungeons.description: An island in Etheria under the rule of Boulder Lord Vakron and guarded by his spirits.\\nThis island became the stronghold of Vakron after he crossed into Atreia to punish the spirits of Atreia who refused the call of the Spirit Realm.\\nOnce an ordinary floating island, it now exudes a mystical aura and teems with empowered flora and mutated creatures shaped by the energy of the Spirit Realm.

dungeons.name: Valka's Nest
dungeons.description: The nest of the Mutant Valka, a giant insectoid that was mutated by contaminants leaking out from the crashed Dredgion.

dungeons.name: Victims' Cave
dungeons.description: The place where the soul-shattered cadets of Destruction Archons, slain for defying Hystan's command, are imprisoned in eternal despair

dungeons.name: Warriors' Rest
dungeons.description: A sanctum where the Destruction Archon, sworn to Zikel, find rest. Known as the Warriors' Rest, this ancient site is rumored to hold relics tied to Zikel.

dungeons.name: Watcher's Temporary Outpost
dungeons.description: A Draconute battalion is being temporarily stationed here to keep an eye on the Calderon Canyon.

dungeons.name: Wedding Hall
dungeons.description: Wedding Hall

dungeons.name: Where Fossa Escaped
dungeons.description: Where Fossa Escaped

dungeons.name: Wild Biruta Habitat
dungeons.description: A cave inhabited by Biruta—unique creatures found in Tolbas Forest and prized by the Shugo for the special properties of their leaves. The gentle-natured Biruta live quietly in small family groups throughout the cave.

dungeons.name: Wild Kuru Habitat
dungeons.description: A rest stop for Kuru working under the Aullaeu, where they can often be seen lounging around after a hard day's work.

Worshiper's Underground Cave
dungeons.description: Zikel's zealots grow their power within these underground caves. Corrupted followers blindly worship the kept records of Zikel, spreading false faith throughout Altgard.

dungeons.name: Zikel's Collapsed Barracks
dungeons.description: A barracks once used by the Destruction Archons, followers of the Empyrean Lord of Destruction, until it was destroyed by the Balaur and left in its current state.\\nBlaming themselves for their failure to protect their Empyrean Lord, the Archons became Apparitions after death and now attack all who enter their sanctuary.

dungeons.name: Zikel's Sanctum
dungeons.description: The sanctum of Zikel, Empyrean Lord of Destruction, and home base of the Destruction Archons. A major battlefield during the Balaur invasion, it is now largely destroyed and abandoned. None dare visit due to rumors that Empyrean Lord Zikel went mad and wiped out all of the Archons.

dungeons.name: Zumion Relic Storage
dungeons.description: Zumion, the first Daeva, was granted relics and a temple of her own by AION.\\nEnvious of this, Dragon Lord Meslamtaeda invaded and destroyed the temple, turning the priests within to stone.\\nNo one knows if any safe place may be left in the once-submerged temple.
